documentation.title: New Typed Properties
documentation.standard:
Typed properties are supported since PHP 7.4.
At introduction, scalar types, array, object and class/interface name types were supported, including the nullable version of these. Type syntax introduced in later PHP versions, like union types (PHP 8.0) or the `true` type (PHP 8.2), is also supported for typed properties as of the PHP version in which the type syntax was introduced.
